description: Returns the 10 highest Buildix Trader Scores among the large Hyperliquid accounts Buildix tracks: wallet address, label, score from 0 to 100, confidence (low, medium, high) and a style badge. The score ranks risk-adjusted return, profit factor, consistency, drawdown, profit concentration and effective leverage against the tracked set, shrunk toward the median when history is short. History counts from 2026-09-30 and position changes under $50,000 are not seen. Use it when the user asks which Hyperliquid wallets show skill or which wallets to study before copy trading. Data only: Buildix does not execute trades.

detail.description: "brief" (default) returns labels and key numbers. "full" adds the underlying values, data age and method notes.
